text: This is Oog.
scene: {CAVE} smiling in a cave, sparkles

text: Oog is forty thousand years old.
scene: a timeline, a stone tablet with "40000", {CAVE} proud

text: And this morning,
scene: {CAVE} asleep in a cave, z letters

text: he woke up in your city.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a city street, an exclamation mark

text: We're going to drop him into eleven modern places
scene: {CAVE} confused in a city street, the word "ELEVEN" above him

text: and start a timer.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a city street, a clock [TIMER 0:00]

text: In one place, he lasts all day.
scene: {CAVE} asleep in a library, z letters [TIMER ALL DAY]

text: In another, about four seconds.
scene: {CAVE} terrified on a highway with cars, an exclamation mark [TIMER 4 SEC]

text: And the place that's actually deadly for him
scene: {CAVE} smiling in a waiting room, a question mark

text: isn't the one you think.
scene: {SCI} shocked in a lab, a big question mark

text: First, the rules.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "RULES" above him

text: Oog is a real Homo sapiens.
scene: {SCI} proud next to {CAVE} smiling, a chalkboard

text: Same species as you. Same brain size.
scene: {SCI} pointing at {CAVE} thinking, a chalkboard, the word "SAME" above them

text: He's tough, he's fit, and he's very good with a spear.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, in a cave

text: But he has never seen a wheel,
scene: {CAVE} confused, the word "WHEEL" above him, a question mark

text: a door handle,
scene: {CAVE} confused, the word "HANDLE" above him, a question mark

text: or a written word.
scene: {CAVE} confused, the word "WORDS" above him, a question mark

text: He doesn't speak any language you know.
scene: {CAVE} shouting in a city street, the word "OOG" above him

text: The timer stops when he's thrown out,
scene: a security guard angry, pointing, the word "OUT" above him

text: arrested,
scene: a police officer frowning next to {CAVE} sad, the word "ARRESTED" above them

text: or rescued.
scene: a police officer smiling next to {CAVE} relieved, the word "RESCUED" above them

text: Let's go, from the longest stay to the shortest.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, a clock [TIMER 0:00]

text: Place one: the library.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a library, the word "LIBRARY" above him

text: It's quiet.
scene: {CAVE} smiling in a library, the word "SHH" above him

text: It's warm.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a library, sparkles

text: Nobody is shouting, and nothing is trying to eat him.
scene: {CAVE} relieved in a library, sparkles

text: To Oog, this is the best cave he has ever seen.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a library, hearts, the word "CAVE" above him

text: He doesn't understand books.
scene: {CAVE} confused holding a book in a library, a question mark

text: Writing was only invented about five thousand years ago.
scene: a timeline, a stone tablet with "5000", the word "WRITING" above it

text: For Oog, that's thirty-five thousand years in the future.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a library, a timeline, an exclamation mark

text: So he does what any hunter does in a safe, dark cave.
scene: {CAVE} smug in a library, the word "SAFE" above him

text: He sleeps.
scene: {CAVE} asleep in a library, z letters

text: The librarian shushes him twice.
scene: a librarian frowning in a library, {CAVE} asleep, the word "SHH" above them

text: Then the building closes.
scene: a librarian pointing at {CAVE} confused in a library at night, the word "CLOSED" above them

text: Timer: all day.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a library, sparkles [TIMER ALL DAY]

text: Place two: the gym.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a gym, the word "GYM" above him

text: Oog is not impressed.
scene: {CAVE} smug in a gym, a treadmill

text: Hunter-gatherers like the Hadza in Tanzania
scene: a Hadza hunter smiling on a savanna, the word "HADZA" above him

text: can walk about ten kilometers a day,
scene: a Hadza hunter proud on a savanna, the word "10 KM" above him

text: just to find food.
scene: a Hadza hunter happy on a savanna, a fish

text: And here, people walk for an hour
scene: {GUY} sweating on a treadmill in a gym

text: and never arrive anywhere.
scene: {CAVE} confused watching {GUY} on a treadmill in a gym, a big question mark

text: Oog finds the heaviest stone in the building.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, lifting a dumbbell in a gym

text: In his world, a good heavy stone is a treasure.
scene: {CAVE} happy holding a dumbbell, sparkles, the word "TREASURE" above him

text: So he takes it home.
scene: {CAVE} smug holding a dumbbell, walking out of a gym

text: Thief.
scene: a security guard angry, pointing at {CAVE} shocked, the word "THIEF" above them

text: Timer: six hours.
scene: {CAVE} sad outside a gym [TIMER 6 HOURS]

text: Place three: an office.
scene: {CAVE} confused in an office with a computer, the word "OFFICE" above him

text: Everyone sits on a chair for eight hours.
scene: three {GUY} bored at desks in an office

text: Oog has never sat on a chair.
scene: {CAVE} confused next to a chair in an office, a question mark

text: When Hadza people rest, they often squat or kneel,
scene: a Hadza hunter smiling, squatting on a savanna

text: and that keeps their muscles a little busy.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "SQUAT" above him

text: Oog squats on top of the desk.
scene: {CAVE} smug on a desk in an office, {GUY} shocked

text: Then comes the meeting.
scene: four {GUY} bored around a table in an office, the word "MEETING" above them

text: Forty minutes of talking, and nobody hunts anything.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a meeting in an office, the word "HUNT" above him, a big red X

text: So Oog goes hunting.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, in an office

text: He cooks his catch in the kitchen.
scene: {CAVE} happy by a microwave in an office kitchen, a fish

text: It's a fish.
scene: {GUY} disgusted in an office kitchen, the word "FISH" above him, a fish

text: In the microwave.
scene: three {GUY} angry in an office kitchen, the word "MICROWAVE" above them, an exclamation mark

text: Timer: three hours.
scene: {CAVE} sad outside an office [TIMER 3 HOURS]

text: Place four: the zoo.
scene: {CAVE} confused at a zoo, the word "ZOO" above him

text: He walks past the lions, and shrugs.
scene: {CAVE} shrugging next to a lion in a cage at a zoo

text: In Ice Age Europe, Oog shared the land
scene: a timeline, {CAVE} and a lion, a stone tablet with "40000"

text: with cave lions that were even bigger than today's lions.
scene: {CAVE} terrified next to a lion in the snow, the word "BIGGER" above him

text: A lion in a cage? Boring.
scene: {CAVE} bored next to a lion in a cage at a zoo, the word "BORING" above him

text: But then he sees the petting zoo.
scene: {CAVE} shocked at a petting zoo, a goat, an exclamation mark

text: A goat walks up to him and wants to be patted.
scene: a goat happy next to {CAVE} terrified at a petting zoo, hearts

text: This breaks Oog's brain.
scene: {CAVE} shocked, hands on his head, a goat, an exclamation mark

text: Goats were only tamed around ten thousand years ago.
scene: a timeline, a goat, a stone tablet with "10000"

text: In Oog's world, every animal either runs away or attacks.
scene: {CAVE} scared, a wolf angry in the snow, the word "RUN" above him

text: An animal that walks up to you must be sick.
scene: {CAVE} confused next to a goat at the zoo, the word "SICK" above them, a question mark

text: Or dinner.
scene: {CAVE} happy next to a goat at the zoo, the word "DINNER" above him, sparkles

text: The zookeeper disagrees.
scene: a zookeeper angry, pointing at {CAVE} shocked, a goat, the word "NO" above them

text: Timer: two hours.
scene: {CAVE} sad outside a zoo [TIMER 2 HOURS]

text: Place five: an all-you-can-eat buffet.
scene: {CAVE} shocked at a buffet, sparkles, the word "BUFFET" above him

text: Oog has never seen this much food in one place.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, at a buffet, sparkles

text: For the Hadza, the sweetest food in the world is wild honey.
scene: a Hadza hunter happy on a savanna, the word "HONEY" above him

text: It can make up around fifteen percent of their calories in a year.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "15%" above him

text: Here, there's a chocolate fountain.
scene: {CAVE} shocked at a buffet, the word "CHOCOLATE" above him, sparkles

text: So Oog eats.
scene: {CAVE} happy eating at a buffet

text: And eats.
scene: {CAVE} happy eating at a buffet, hearts

text: His body has one rule: when there's food, store it.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "STORE" above him

text: The next meal could be days away.
scene: {CAVE} sad in the snow at night, the word "HUNGRY" above him

text: So he wraps every rib he can carry in his fur.
scene: {CAVE} smug at a buffet, the word "RIBS" above him

text: "All you can eat" does not mean "all you can carry."
scene: a waiter angry, pointing at {CAVE} shocked at a buffet, the word "CARRY" above them, a big red X

text: Timer: forty-five minutes.
scene: {CAVE} sad outside a restaurant [TIMER 45 MIN]

text: Place six: the supermarket.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a supermarket, the word "SUPERMARKET" above him

text: A typical American supermarket sells about thirty thousand different products.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a supermarket, the word "30000 ITEMS" above him

text: Oog's whole world had maybe a few hundred things to eat.
scene: {CAVE} thinking in a forest, a fish, the word "FEW" above him

text: And nobody here is guarding the food.
scene: {CAVE} smug in a supermarket, a question mark

text: So, it's free.
scene: {CAVE} happy eating in a supermarket, sparkles, the word "FREE" above him

text: He opens a bag of chips.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a supermarket, the word "CHIPS" above him

text: He bites a coconut.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a supermarket, the word "COCONUT" above him

text: He drinks the milk straight from the bottle.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a supermarket, the word "MILK" above him

text: Fun fact: Oog probably can't digest milk well as an adult.
scene: {SCI} smug at a chalkboard, the word "MILK" above him, a big red X

text: Most adults in the Ice Age couldn't.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, a timeline

text: That came much later, with dairy farming.
scene: a farmer smiling in a village, the word "DAIRY" above him

text: Security arrives first,
scene: a security guard angry in a supermarket, pointing at {CAVE} sweating

text: just before the stomach ache does.
scene: {CAVE} sad, hands on his head, in a supermarket, the word "OUCH" above him

text: Timer: twenty minutes.
scene: {CAVE} sad outside a supermarket [TIMER 20 MIN]

text: Place seven: the shopping mall.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a mall, the word "MALL" above him

text: Stairs? Oog knows stairs.
scene: {CAVE} smug next to stairs in a mall

text: Rocks, slopes, cliffs. Easy.
scene: {CAVE} proud on a rocky cliff, the word "EASY" above him

text: But these stairs move.
scene: {CAVE} shocked on an escalator in a mall, an exclamation mark

text: The moving staircase is a pretty new invention.
scene: {GUY} smiling on an escalator in a mall, the word "ESCALATOR" above him

text: One of the first ran at Coney Island in eighteen ninety-six, just as a ride.
scene: {GUY} happy on an escalator in a mall, a stone tablet with "1896", sparkles

text: For Oog, the ground itself is alive.
scene: {CAVE} terrified, hands on his head, on an escalator in a mall

text: So he does the logical thing.
scene: {CAVE} thinking on an escalator, a light bulb above him

text: He attacks the stairs.
scene: {CAVE} angry, holding a spear, on an escalator in a mall

text: Then he rides them.
scene: {CAVE} happy on an escalator in a mall, sparkles

text: Up. Down. Up. Down.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, on an escalator in a mall, hearts

text: Forty times.
scene: {CAVE} happy on an escalator in a mall, the word "40 TIMES" above him

text: Timer: five minutes.
scene: a security guard frowning, pointing at {CAVE} sad in a mall [TIMER 5 MIN]

text: Place eight: airport security.
scene: {CAVE} confused at airport security, the word "AIRPORT" above him

text: He walks in with a spear.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, at airport security, a guard shocked

text: And a stone knife.
scene: {CAVE} smug at airport security, the word "KNIFE" above him

text: And his water, in a bag made from an animal's stomach.
scene: {CAVE} happy at airport security, the word "WATER" above him

text: Liquids over a hundred milliliters? Not allowed.
scene: a guard frowning at airport security, the word "100 ML" above him, a big red X

text: Then the body scanner spins around him.
scene: {CAVE} terrified inside a body scanner at airport security

text: To Oog, this is a spirit trying to look inside him.
scene: {CAVE} terrified at airport security, the word "SPIRIT" above him, an exclamation mark

text: He wins the fight with the scanner.
scene: {CAVE} angry, holding a spear, at airport security, the word "WIN" above him

text: He does not win the fight with airport police.
scene: two police officers angry next to {CAVE} sad at airport security

text: Timer: two minutes.
scene: {CAVE} sad at airport security [TIMER 2 MIN]

text: Place nine: the subway.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a subway station, the word "SUBWAY" above him

text: A giant metal animal screams out of a dark cave.
scene: {CAVE} terrified, a subway train in a subway station, an exclamation mark

text: The biggest animal Oog ever hunted was a woolly mammoth.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, next to a mammoth in the snow

text: A big one weighed about six tonnes.
scene: a mammoth in the snow, a stone tablet with "6", the word "TONNES" above it

text: One New York subway car weighs over thirty-five tonnes.
scene: a subway train in a subway station, the word "35 TONNES" above it

text: That's six mammoths,
scene: {CAVE} shocked, hands on his head, a subway train, the word "SIX" above him

text: and they come in a herd of ten cars.
scene: {CAVE} terrified in a subway station, a subway train, the word "HERD" above him

text: Oog throws his spear at the train.
scene: {CAVE} angry, holding a spear, a subway train in a subway station, an exclamation mark

text: The train doesn't notice.
scene: a subway train in a subway station, {CAVE} confused, a question mark

text: The station staff do.
scene: a guard angry in a subway station, pointing at {CAVE} sad

text: Timer: one minute.
scene: {CAVE} sad in a subway station [TIMER 1 MIN]

text: Place ten: a highway.
scene: {CAVE} confused on a highway with cars, the word "HIGHWAY" above him

text: Oog knows fast.
scene: {CAVE} smug, holding a spear, on a savanna

text: A charging lion can hit around eighty kilometers an hour.
scene: a lion angry on a savanna, the word "80 KMH" above it

text: Highway cars go faster, and there are hundreds of them.
scene: {CAVE} shocked on a highway with cars, the word "120 KMH" above him

text: And judging fast cars is hard even for us.
scene: {SCI} thinking in a lab, a light bulb above him

text: In one study, many children under ten couldn't tell a car was coming
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, a car, the word "KIDS" above him

text: once it went faster than about thirty kilometers an hour.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "30 KMH" above him, a big red X

text: Oog's brain has never practiced this at all.
scene: {CAVE} confused on a highway with cars, a big question mark

text: So he does what worked on lions.
scene: {CAVE} thinking on a highway, a light bulb above him

text: He freezes.
scene: {CAVE} terrified, frozen on a highway with cars, an exclamation mark

text: Ten horns, one police car, and a very confused officer later...
scene: a police officer shocked on a highway with cars, {CAVE} terrified, an exclamation mark

text: Timer: four seconds.
scene: a police officer smiling next to {CAVE} relieved on a highway [TIMER 4 SEC]

text: So the highway is the most dangerous place, right?
scene: {CAVE} shocked on a highway with cars, a big question mark

text: Actually, no.
scene: {SCI} smug in a lab, the word "NO" above him

text: Oog survived the highway. Police are nice to confused people.
scene: a police officer smiling next to {CAVE} relieved, hearts

text: The place that could actually kill him
scene: {CAVE} smiling in a waiting room, a question mark

text: looks completely safe.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a waiting room, sparkles

text: Place eleven: a doctor's waiting room.
scene: {CAVE} smiling in a waiting room, the word "WAITING ROOM" above him

text: Soft chairs. Old magazines. Somebody coughing.
scene: {GUY} sad, coughing in a waiting room, the word "COUGH" above him

text: Here's the problem.
scene: {SCI} thinking in a lab with a microscope

text: Many of our worst crowd diseases are younger than farming.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, a timeline, the word "FARMING" above him

text: They spread when people lived packed together with cattle, pigs and chickens.
scene: a farmer worried in a crowded village, the word "GERMS" above him

text: Measles, for example, may only be about two and a half thousand years old.
scene: {SCI} shocked at a microscope in a lab, the word "MEASLES" above him

text: Oog has never met it.
scene: {CAVE} smiling in a waiting room, a question mark

text: No vaccines. No childhood colds from a playground full of kids.
scene: {SCI} sad at a chalkboard, the word "VACCINES" above him, a big red X

text: And measles is one of the most contagious diseases we know.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "CONTAGIOUS" above him

text: One sick person with no protection around them can infect twelve to eighteen others.
scene: {SCI} shocked at a chalkboard, the word "12 TO 18" above him, an exclamation mark

text: Oog sits in the waiting room for an hour.
scene: {CAVE} bored in a waiting room, {GUY} sad, coughing

text: He feels fine.
scene: {CAVE} happy, thumbs up, in a waiting room, sparkles

text: The highway took four seconds.
scene: {CAVE} terrified on a highway with cars [TIMER 4 SEC]

text: The waiting room takes about ten days.
scene: {CAVE} sad, sweating, in bed at night, the word "FEVER" above him [TIMER 10 DAYS]

text: The scariest thing in our world isn't a car.
scene: {CAVE} sad in a bed, a car, a big red X

text: It's the invisible stuff we've been protected from since we were babies.
scene: {SCI} proud at a microscope in a lab, the word "INVISIBLE" above him

text: And luckily, a doctor is already in the next room.
scene: a doctor smiling next to {CAVE} relieved, hearts [TIMER SAVED]

text: So, is Oog just too primitive for the modern world?
scene: {CAVE} sad in a city street, a question mark

text: Not at all.
scene: {SCI} smiling at a chalkboard, the word "NO" above him

text: Take Oog as a baby,
scene: a baby {CAVE} smiling in a living room, hearts

text: and raise him in your town.
scene: a baby {CAVE} happy with a modern woman in a living room, hearts

text: He'd learn to read.
scene: {CAVE} smiling holding a book in a library, sparkles

text: He'd ride the subway, bored, on his phone.
scene: {CAVE} bored in a subway station, the word "PHONE" above him

text: He'd complain about the office microwave.
scene: {CAVE} angry in an office kitchen, the word "FISH" above him

text: Same brain. Same species. Just born forty thousand years too early.
scene: a timeline, {CAVE} and {GUY} in a row, hearts, sparkles

text: The only thing the modern world has that Oog didn't
scene: {GUY} smiling in a city street, a question mark

text: is everything people built after him.
scene: a timeline, {CAVE}, a farmer and {GUY} in a row, the word "AFTER" above them

text: And now, the question everyone asks in the comments:
scene: {CAVE} smug in a cave, a big question mark

text: how long would you last in his world?
scene: {GUY} terrified in the snow at night, a wolf angry [TIMER ?]

text: Spoiler: probably less than four seconds.
scene: {CAVE} laughing in a cave, pointing, the word "4 SEC" above him

text: Oog will be in the library.
scene: {CAVE} asleep in a library, z letters, sparkles [TIMER ALL DAY]
